hero.title: Manage World Bank-financed projects from inception to impact
hero.subtitle: PIIMS unifies project registry, inception stage-gates, results framework, financing, procurement and impact measurement in one bilingual, offline-capable system.

features.title: One platform for the full project cycle
features.subtitle: From project idea to measurable impact — bilingual, offline-capable and auditable by design.
features.m1d: Idea to approval with stage gates, components and a full audit trail.
features.m2d: Stage-gated inception reports, indicators and achievement tracking.
features.m3d: Budgets, disbursements, FMIS reconciliation and contract monitoring.
features.m4d: Registration, duplicate checks, verification and service delivery.
features.m5d: Surveys, CAPI field collection, QA review and an anonymized data warehouse.
features.m6d: 43 roles with fine-grained permissions, MFA and complete auditability.

about.title: Ownership & financing
about.body: PIIMS is owned by the Ministry of Water and Energy of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia and financed by the World Bank.
